description.value: Harvest Rd. is a farm-to-table outdoor dining and takeout spot located directly on the Lochside Trail Bicycling Path, making it a natural and convenient stop for cyclists travelling between Victoria and Sidney. The menu draws heavily from the adjacent Michell's Farm Market, with house-ground burgers, sandwiches, hot dogs, and custom cold-pressed apple juice all featuring locally raised and grown ingredients. Harvest Rd. holds the highest recognition from the Vancouver Island Green Business Certification Program and was named the Greenest Restaurant on Vancouver Island in 2017, operating a fully zero-waste service model with compostable packaging.
